capital.evidence_quote: Ulaanbaatar is the capital and largest city of Mongolia, home to almost half the population

currency.evidence_quote: The Mongolian Tögrög (MNT) is the official national currency of Mongolia

timezone.evidence_quote: Central and eastern Mongolia observes Ulaanbaatar Time UTC+8 without daylight saving time

voltage.evidence_quote: Standard residential domestic supply voltage across Mongolia is 220V 50 Hz

frequency_hz.evidence_quote: Grid frequency throughout Mongolia operates at 50 Hz

plug_types.evidence_quote: Standard sockets in Mongolia accommodate Europlug Type C and grounded Type E plugs

police.evidence_quote: Dial 102 for emergency police services across Mongolia

ambulance.evidence_quote: Call 103 for emergency ambulance and urgent medical dispatch

fire.evidence_quote: Dial 101 for fire and technical rescue brigades

general.evidence_quote: Call 105 for integrated disaster rescue and wilderness emergency coordination

tourist_police.evidence_quote: Tourist Police department patrols Sukhbaatar Square and Peace Avenue with English support

source.title: US Department of State Travel Advisory

advisory_headline.tr: Moğolistan genelinde güvenlik ortamı çok huzurludur; kış aylarında aşırı soğuk hava şartlarına (Dzud) hazırlıklı olunmalıdır.
advisory_headline.en: Exercise normal precautions; winter temperatures can be severe (-30°C to -40°C), requiring thermal gear.
advisory_headline.de: In der Mongolei gelten normale Sicherheitsvorkehrungen; im Winter auf extreme Kälte vorbereiten.
advisory_headline.ru: В Монголии действует нормальный уровень безопасности; зимой учитывайте суровые морозы (дзуд).
advisory_headline.es: Aplican precauciones normales de viaje; en invierno prepárese para temperaturas bajo cero extremas.

mobile_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median mobile broadband download speeds in Mongolia reach approximately 31.5 Mbps

fixed_down_mbps.evidence_quote: Median fixed broadband download speeds in Mongolia measure 54.8 Mbps

esim_sim_notes.value: Unitel and Mobicom offer prepaid 4G/LTE tourist eSIMs. Connectivity is fast across Ulaanbaatar, but drops in the remote Gobi Desert and western Altai steppes; carry offline maps and a satellite tracker.
esim_sim_notes.evidence_quote: Prepaid cellular plans provide nationwide coverage along main national highway corridors

tr.conditions: Türkiye Cumhuriyeti umuma mahsus, hususi ve hizmet pasaportu hamilleri 30 güne kadar vizeden muaftır.

us.conditions: US citizens can travel to Mongolia visa-free for tourist stays of up to 90 days.

de.conditions: German and EU citizens enjoy visa-free entry to Mongolia for stays of up to 30 days under the tourism campaign.

gb.conditions: British citizens can visit Mongolia visa-free for up to 30 days for tourism purposes.

ru.conditions: Граждане РФ могут въезжать в Монголию без визы на срок до 30 дней (не более 90 дней суммарно за 180 дней).

dos.title: Never step on the threshold of a Ger
dos.description: Stepping on the wooden door threshold of a traditional nomadic tent (Ger / Yurt) is seen as stepping on the host's neck.

dos.title: Accept offered milk tea (Suutei Tsai) with both hands
dos.description: Always accept bowls of tea, dairy curds (Aaruul), or vodka with the right hand supported at the elbow by the left hand.

dos.title: Walk around Buddhist ovoos clockwise three times
dos.description: When passing sacred roadside rock cairns (Ovoo), walk around them three times clockwise and add a small stone for safe travels.

donts.title: Don't whistle inside a Ger
donts.description: Whistling indoors is believed to summon violent windstorms and bad fortune.

donts.title: Don't cross between the two central support pillars of a Ger
donts.description: The central roof poles represent the spiritual pillar of the household; walking between them breaks sacred harmony.

etiquette.tipping: Tipping is not customary in traditional Mongolian culture, but 10% in Ulaanbaatar restaurants or tips for expedition drivers and camp cooks are appreciated.
